description: Storeganise is self-storage management software. This plugin reads sites, units, users, invoices, unit rentals, jobs and add-ons from the Admin API, updates unit-rental custom fields (access codes, overlock flags), and verifies the signed webhook deliveries Storeganise sends for system events.

api.description: Read one add-on record with its operator credentials
List the add-ons installed on the account

output.type: { id: string, customFields?: Record<string, any> | null }[]

api.description: List invoices, filtered by update time or fetched in batches of ids

fields.description: Only records updated at or after this UTC time, formatted as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.000Z.
Up to 50 record ids, sent comma-separated in one call.

api.description: Read one job by the id a webhook delivery carries
Read the business settings, including the webhook secret
Read one storage site by id or code

fields.description: Site id or site code, e.g. "central".

api.description: List storage sites, optionally filtered by a search term

fields.description: Search filter, including custom fields, e.g. "customField:foo".
